The links to lean4web in https://github.com/PatrickMassot/GlimpseOfLean?tab=readme-ov-file are broken.

eg https://live.lean-lang.org/#project=GlimpseOfLean&url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FPatrickMassot%2FGlimpseOfLean%2Frefs%2Fheads%2Fmaster%2FGlimpseOfLean%2FExercises%2F03Forall.lean gives the error message

Error: failed to load code from https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FPatrickMassot%2FGlimpseOfLean%2Frefs%2Fheads%2Fmaster%2FGlimpseOfLean%2FExercises%2F03Forall.lean

It seems to be something to do with the URL escapes: loading from the web location manually works fine.
This is very new and unfortunate. @Jon Eugster or @Joachim Breitner do you have any idea what’s happening?
unescaped links are still working. I've started looking into what broke with escaped links. I'll probably have a fix restoring the old behaviour at some point next week
So this is upstream and nothing I have to deal with today? :-)
@Jon Eugster did you end having to fix that link issue? I wanted to check but the server appears to be down currently. I’d like to use GlimpseOfLean online tomorrow.
I merged a fix the other day but I haven't told @Joachim Breitner to update yet.
although on https://lean.math.hhu.de it doesn't quite seem to work what does locally, so maybe that's not a fix yet :(
So maybe I don’t consider myself told yet :-)

I was told after all. Updating, let’s see if it works on our server.
@Patrick Massot , what does work is telling user to use Load → Load from URL and then paste the URL. But let’s see if the links work as well after the update.
It seems to work indeed, thanks Jon and Joachim!
Actually it seems to no longer work :sad:
And works again. I think @Joscha Mennicken deployed shortly after me but without my changes (yet). A bit busy right now.
Thanks Joachim! Sorry for the lack of proper testing
